name: Real Estate — Diminishing Musharaka
_note: PLACEHOLDER CONDITIONS. These illustrate the mechanism, not certified Shariah criteria. Thresholds and permitted-activity lists must be set by an actual Shariah Supervisory Board. The engine applies whatever conditions a board defines; it does not decide them.

conditions.description: The asset must be real estate. This template was certified for that asset class only; other classes require fresh board review.
The asset must be specifically identified by title reference. Unspecified or fungible pools introduce gharar (excessive uncertainty).
The issuer must hold clean title. Ownership must genuinely transfer to the SPV, not merely appear to.
The asset must be free of existing charges, mortgages or liens that would conflict with investor ownership.
Returns must derive from rent on a real asset, never from interest on a loan. Interest-bearing income is riba.
Rent from a prohibited business activity is impure income. Business-activity screening applies to whoever occupies the asset.
Incidental impure income must stay below 5% of gross income, and the impure portion must be purified through charitable donation (tathir).
A majority of the underlying must be tangible assets rather than receivables, otherwise the instrument becomes debt-like and cannot be freely traded on the secondary market.
The owner must retain genuine ownership risk — major maintenance, insurance, total loss. A lease that passes every risk to the lessee is a loan in costume.
Buyback must not be fixed at face value. A purchase undertaking at par effectively guarantees principal, reintroducing exactly what the structure exists to avoid.
